title: Excavations near foundations.
officialText: Excavations for any purpose shall not remove vertical or lateral support from any foundation without first underpinning or protecting the foundation against settlement or lateral translation. Where required, underpinning or shoring shall be provided in accordance with Section 1814.
previewText: Excavations for any purpose shall not remove vertical or lateral support from any foundation without first underpinning or protecting the foundation against settlement or lateral translation. Where required, underpinning or shoring shall be provided in accordance with Section 1814.
